ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A certain wet material is dried adiabatically in an atmospheric-pressure dryer. The flow rate of the dried product is 4000kg/h, the moisture content of the wet material is 15\% (wet basis), and the moisture content of the product must not be higher than 1\%. The initial temperature of the air is 20°C, and the relative humidity is 40\%. After the air is preheated to 120°C, it enters the dryer, and the temperature of the gas leaving the dryer is selected as 70°C. The change process of the air and the material in the drying system is as shown in the figure. Find the thermal efficiency of the dryer.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A certain wet material is dried adiabatically in an atmospheric-pressure dryer. The flow rate of the dried product is 4000kg/h, the moisture content of the wet material is 15\% (wet basis), and the moisture content of the product must not be higher than 1\%. The initial temperature of the air is 20°C, and the relative humidity is 40\%. After the air is preheated to 120°C, it enters the dryer, and the temperature of the gas leaving the dryer is selected as 70°C. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, air enters from the left side, and the initial state is labeled as t0=20°C, φ0=40%; then it passes through the "preheater" marked with Qp heating, and the air state after preheating is labeled as t1=120°C, H1; then it enters the "drying" device; on the right side of the dryer outlet is waste gas, labeled t2=70°C, H2. In the figure, the material enters the dryer from below, the moisture content of the wet material is w1=15%, the product flow rate is G2=4000 kg/h, and the product moisture content is w2≤1%. Then reason: The problem states that adiabatic drying is carried out inside the dryer, and the heat Qp in the figure is added only to the preheater. According to the specified method, the thermal efficiency of the dryer is taken as the ratio of the effective cooling of the air inside the dryer to the total temperature rise in the preheater, namely η=(t1-t2)/(t1-t0)×100%. Substituting t0=20°C, t1=120°C, t2=70°C gives η=(120-70)/(120-20)×100%=50/100×100%=50%. The material flow rate and moisture content can be used for a water balance, but they do not need to be used when solving according to this efficiency formula.

raw_record.question_text: A certain wet material is dried adiabatically in an atmospheric-pressure dryer. The flow rate of the dried product is 4000kg/h, the moisture content of the wet material is 15\% (wet basis), and the moisture content of the product must not be higher than 1\%. The initial temperature of the air is 20°C, and the relative humidity is 40\%. After the air is preheated to 120°C, it enters the dryer, and the temperature of the gas leaving the dryer is selected as 70°C. The change process of the air and the material in the drying system is as shown in the figure. Find the thermal efficiency of the dryer.

method.method_draft: 根据图示流程确定三个关键空气温度：初始空气 t0=20°C，预热后进干燥器 t1=120°C，出干燥器废气 t2=70°C。由题干“绝热干燥”和图中 Qp 仅加在预热器上，使用干燥器热效率公式 η=(t1-t2)/(t1-t0)×100%。代入 η=(120-70)/(120-20)×100%=50%。题中物料流量和含水率可用于水分衡算，但求该效率时不必使用。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中空气从左侧进入，标注初始状态为 t0=20°C、φ0=40%；随后经过标有 Qp 加热的“预热”器，预热后空气状态标注为 t1=120°C、H1；再进入“干燥”器；干燥器出口右侧为废气，标注 t2=70°C、H2。图中物料从下方进入干燥器，湿物料含水率 w1=15%，产品流量 G2=4000 kg/h，产品含水率 w2≤1%。再推理：题目说明干燥器内为绝热干燥，且图中热量 Qp 只加在预热器上。按指定方法，干燥器热效率取空气在干燥器内有效降温与预热器中总升温之比，即 η=(t1-t2)/(t1-t0)×100%。代入 t0=20°C、t1=120°C、t2=70°C，得 η=(120-70)/(120-20)×100%=50/100×100%=50%。物料流量和含水率可用于水分衡算，但按该效率公式求解时不需要使用。
method.answer_match_reason: The standard answer is 50 for the dryer thermal efficiency; the predicted answer gives 50%, which is the same value expressed with the appropriate percentage unit for an efficiency.

answer_match_part_results.reason: For thermal efficiency, 50 and 50% are equivalent in this context, with the predicted answer explicitly including the percent sign.
